name: No Thanks! (Two-Lap)
summary: Players pay chips to refuse unwanted numbered cards or take the card with its chip pot. A card nobody takes in two full laps is burned. The lowest card points minus chips wins.

player.meaning: Chips the player holds. Only the owner sees them during play; they are revealed at the end.
Cards the player has taken, face up.
Sum of the lowest card of each run of consecutive numbers in the tableau.

game.meaning: Cards set aside at setup. No player ever sees them.
The card on offer; 0 means no card is on offer.
Chips paid onto the table, won by whoever takes a card.
Full laps the current card has gone without being taken.
The seat that receives the first offer in a lap.
Cards burned after two untaken laps.
Scratch counter of rounds played, used for the 40-round cap.

setup: Seats are numbered 1 to N (N = 3 or 4); clockwise means seat s is followed by seat s+1, and seat N is followed by seat 1.
Shuffle the 33 cards numbered 3 to 35. Put 20 of them, in random order, into the hidden deck and the other 13 into the hidden removed list.
Each player gets chips = 11 (seen only by its owner), an empty public tableau and card_points = 0.
Set current_card = 0, pot = 0, lap_count = 0, lead_seat = 1, an empty public burned list and round_count = 0.

round.effect: Set round_count += 1. When current_card = 0 and deck is not empty, draw one card at random from deck and set current_card to it, removing it from deck. The pot is not reset.
Announce current_card, pot, every tableau and the burned list.

round.who: seat ((lead_seat - 1 + 0) mod N) + 1 (offer k=1); runs only when current_card != 0
round.answer: TAKE, or PAY if that seat has chips >= 1
round.effect: PAY: that seat's chips -= 1 and pot += 1. TAKE: c = current_card; card_points += c; if c+1 is in tableau, card_points -= c+1; if c-1 is in tableau, card_points -= c; append c to tableau; chips += pot; pot = 0; current_card = 0; lap_count = 0; lead_seat = this seat.

round.who: seat ((lead_seat - 1 + 1) mod N) + 1 (offer k=2); runs only when current_card != 0
round.answer: TAKE, or PAY if that seat has chips >= 1

round.who: seat ((lead_seat - 1 + 2) mod N) + 1 (offer k=3); runs only when current_card != 0
round.answer: TAKE, or PAY if that seat has chips >= 1

round.who: seat ((lead_seat - 1 + 3) mod N) + 1 (offer k=4); runs only when N = 4 and current_card != 0
round.answer: TAKE, or PAY if that seat has chips >= 1

round.effect: BURN: when current_card != 0 and lap_count >= 2, append current_card to burned, then set current_card = 0 and lap_count = 0. pot and lead_seat are unchanged.
Send each player its own chips and the public state.
End the game when (current_card = 0 and deck is empty) or round_count >= 40. Otherwise continue.
Run the round steps again until the check ends the game. At the end, reveal every player's chips and tableau to all players.

ending.decided_by: A player's final score is card_points minus chips, and the lowest score wins. The ranking uses chips minus card_points, so the highest value wins, and players tied for the lowest score share the win (a draw among them).

rules.text: At setup, the deck holds 20 cards drawn at random from 3..35, removed holds the other 13 (never shown to any player), each player has chips = 11, an empty tableau and card_points = 0, and the table has current_card = 0, pot = 0, lap_count = 0, lead_seat = 1 and an empty burned list.
When a round starts with current_card = 0 and the deck not empty, then one card moves from the deck to current_card, and the deck shrinks by 1.
When a new card is drawn, then the pot keeps any chips already in it.
When offers are made, then offer k goes to seat ((lead_seat - 1 + k - 1) mod N) + 1, for k = 1..N; with lead_seat = 3 and N = 4 the order is 3, 4, 1, 2, and with N = 3 it is 3, 1, 2.
When current_card = 0, then an offer step is skipped.
When an offered seat has chips >= 1, then it is offered TAKE and PAY; when it has 0 chips, then it is offered only TAKE.
When a seat PAYs, then its chips decrease by 1 and the pot increases by 1.
When a seat TAKEs card c, then its card_points rises by c, minus (c+1) if c+1 is already in its tableau, minus c if c-1 is already in its tableau, and c is appended to its tableau.
When a seat TAKEs, then it gains all the chips in the pot, and the pot becomes 0.
When a seat TAKEs, then current_card = 0, lap_count = 0 and lead_seat = that seat, and the remaining offers in that round are skipped.
When all offers in a round pass without a TAKE, then lap_count increases by 1.
When lap_count reaches 2 with the card still on offer, then current_card is appended to burned, current_card = 0 and lap_count = 0, while the pot and lead_seat are unchanged.
When current_card = 0 and the deck is empty at the end check, then the game ends.
When 40 rounds have been played, then the game ends.
When the game ends, then each player's score is card_points - chips, the lowest score wins, and players tied for lowest share the win.
When the game ends, then every player's chips and tableau are revealed to all players.

offers.question: Offer step: TAKE the current card or PAY 1 chip
offers.who: the offered seat ((lead_seat - 1 + k - 1) mod N) + 1, only while current_card != 0
offers.options: A seat with chips >= 1: TAKE, PAY. A seat with chips = 0: TAKE only.

choices.why: The designer chose 4. At 3 the chip pressure and the pot-baiting still work; above 4 the source rules do not apply.
The rules say there is no talk. The tension comes from reading the pot and the other players' tableaus.
Tableaus are public, so card_points can be worked out by anyone anyway. Making it visible changes no information.
The engine treats the highest value as the winner, so the lowest score becomes the highest negated score.
It is needed to enforce the 40-round cap.

simplifications.what: The clockwise offer loop is written as up to N separate ask steps, each with a seat formula and a when condition
simplifications.why: The engine has a flat step list. The formula reproduces the clockwise order from lead_seat, and the condition skips offers once the card is taken.

simplifications.what: Drawing the top deck card is a random draw from the deck list
simplifications.why: The deck is in random order, so drawing at random is equivalent.
